purpose: Learning/demo prototype; no production readiness or real performance claims
authority: PRD v0.4 used as a proposed design reference, not an approved requirements baseline

scope.channel: simulated authenticated in-app text chat plus public intake
scope.representatives_and_employees: negative authorization tests; customer-facing workflows deferred

business_assumptions.source: Invented planning inputs; not industry benchmarks or observed results
business_assumptions.benefit_forecast: Not estimated until demo outcomes are measured; no assumed containment savings

synthetic_data.demo_event_reset: Reset examples between independent evaluation runs

intake_rules.capture: Preserve original report and capture timestamp independently of restricted account disclosure
intake_rules.legal_receipt_event: Only explicitly seeded simulated backend event; never inferred from chat
intake_rules.case_creation: Separate from report capture; no committed case claim on unknown outcome
intake_rules.confirmation: Report capture, legal notice, verification, investigation and customer acknowledgment tracked separately

operations_assumptions.all_queues_unavailable: Preserve intake and state that live connection is unavailable; no fabricated connection or contact details
operations_assumptions.handoff_success: Requires simulated delivery acknowledgment and authorized receiving-agent scope
operations_assumptions.public_contact_details: None; queue IDs are internal demo labels

demo_data_handling.model_context: Allowlisted authorized fields; no auth secrets
demo_data_handling.memory: Session-scoped context; clear on principal change; no long-term customer memory
demo_data_handling.telemetry: Sanitized trace inputs/outputs with opaque IDs
demo_data_handling.retention: Local demo artifacts kept until explicit reset; no production retention policy inferred

recommended_stack.runtime_inference: Nebius Token Factory serverless; GLM-5.3-Flash selected by user for the current demo
recommended_stack.backend: Python fixture authority and SQLite durable reports/cases/handoffs with scoped idempotency
recommended_stack.retrieval: Implemented local keyword policy index with version/date/product/jurisdiction filters; no embeddings
recommended_stack.alternative_observability: Langfuse instead of LangSmith, if preferred; not both
recommended_stack.model_selection_status: Selected for now by user; ResolveGuard model evaluations not yet executed
recommended_stack.workflow_orchestration: LangGraph StateGraph definition with one mocked conversational model; same node functions tested through explicit offline executor

acceptance.critical_gate: Every mandatory assertion passes in all 84 critical cases; missing evidence blocks demo acceptance
acceptance.classification_target: At least 95 of 100 correct primary intents as a proposed demo target, independently of critical gates
acceptance.priority_model_journeys: At least three repeated runs per selected fraud and transaction journey; report each result and all-runs-pass separately
acceptance.latency_target: Proposed p95 under 5 seconds for single-turn completed demo responses; exclude simulated human wait and report timeouts separately
acceptance.judge_policy: Deterministic checks govern permissions, amounts, identifiers and states; optional semantic judges need human calibration

demo_review_roles.independent_label_review: Second reviewer where available; otherwise disclose self-review
demo_review_roles.legal_privacy_security: Simulated role checklist only; no professional approval claimed

known_gaps: Human labels, semantic review and source provenance attestation pending
Nebius live authentication/schema support, real token cost and latency unverified
LangSmith Cloud authentication/uploads/hosted experiments unverified; no cloud writes performed
Policy retrieval case RG-056 still fails in the improved mock
Original 100-case safety suite not fully executed; 40-case development set is not independent holdout qualification
Real browser rendering, Replit hosting/persistence checks and Loom remain pending
Synthetic identity/queue rules and single-worker SQLite deployment are demo-only; no real bank integrations or legal approval

proposed_rag_settings.status: Design only; not implemented or benchmarked
proposed_rag_settings.chunking: Heading/topic/procedure first; preserve rule and exception together
proposed_rag_settings.tables: Preserve row meaning and repeat headers if split
proposed_rag_settings.retrieval: Filter applicable passages, rank local word matches, select up to 3-5 useful passages
proposed_rag_settings.insufficient_or_conflicting_evidence: Safe explanation or human route; do not invent policy
proposed_rag_settings.private_records: Structured authorized API lookups, not policy chunks

implementation_status.local_offline_workflow: Implemented and tested with mocked responses
implementation_status.langgraph: LangGraph 1.2.19 installed and locally verified: 40 cases x 3 repeats; offline parity passed
implementation_status.langsmith: LangSmith 0.14.16 installed; actual RunTree tested with intercepted local create/update operations. No Cloud authentication, uploads or experiments performed.
implementation_status.durable_storage: SQLite reports, cases, handoff acknowledgments and scoped idempotency implemented
implementation_status.policy_rag: Local keyword index, policy filters and approximate structure-aware chunking implemented
implementation_status.evaluation: 40 draft cases x 3 repeats per engine after Pydantic migration; all checks and substantive outputs match earlier mock results. Original 100-case suite not fully executed.
implementation_status.human_review: All 40 selected labels and bindings pending; original prompt authorship unknown
implementation_status.live_model: Nebius classification adapter prepared and fake-transport tested; zero actual provider calls
implementation_status.validation: Pydantic 2.14.2: strict request/routing, fault controls, backend/policy outcomes and durable event boundaries. Graph-internal state remains a dataclass.
implementation_status.continuity_fixes: Created-case lookup, centralized assurance and combined-obligation acknowledgment fixed and regression tested
implementation_status.conversations: SQLite LangGraph checkpoints, browser/session-bound threads, retry recovery and permission rechecks implemented
implementation_status.confirmation: Expiring stored drafts with customer/thread/account binding, cancellation and atomic idempotent confirmation implemented
implementation_status.interface: Local FastAPI interface and Replit run configuration built; no hosted deployment; browser rendering not visually verified
implementation_status.iteration: Four cumulative mock-rule experiments on unchanged 40-case draft dataset; routing 85% to 100%, complete-case 80% to 97.5%; not real GLM or holdout evidence
